title: Great app
body: I am very much enjoying using it. Could you perhaps add the option to add subtasks from the phone, and also to have the ability to switch the places of the list? Otherwise A great app! When u will add these features I will give it a 5!
author: Doru Cucuietu

title: Fine
body: The app is very handy. It would be even better if there was an option to get reminders more often, for example, the day before the task must be done.
author: Monika Sad

title: Great app
body: Great app, but will it be on apple watch someday?:/
author: Justaskup
